translations.web: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
translations.bsb: But as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed, since you know from whom you have learned them.
translations.kjv: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
translations.asv: But abide thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them.
